meta.triageRationale: A constant change. Grounded by grep (the analyzer was unavailable earlier this session): REPO_TURN_CAPACITY is defined once and read in two places, the capacity gate in sessionQueueWait and the outbox's occupied/total. The claim (acknowledge) re-checks eligibility inside its write transaction, so no structure assumes the value 2. Only two tests hard-code a full house of two and need generalising. No new contract, no schema change, no design choice.

body.focus: Raise the VS Code dev chat's per-repository concurrent turn limit from 2 to 6: REPO_TURN_CAPACITY in vscode-plugin/src/chat/chat-queue-store.ts (used by sessionQueueWait's capacity gate and the outbox's occupied/total display in chat-outbox.ts). Update the two tests that hard-code a full house of 2 (chat-outbox.test.ts capacity projection; chat-queue-routing.test.ts 'waiting approval or retry in A allows B and full capacity queues C') so they fill REPO_TURN_CAPACITY slots instead of exactly two.
body.summary: REPO_TURN_CAPACITY raised from 2 to 6 (commit 180fc0b05). Three tests that assumed exactly two slots (chat-outbox, chat-queue-routing, chat-queue-store) now fill REPO_TURN_CAPACITY slots; the outbox and store tests fail if the gate is off by one. 100/100 chat queue tests pass; plugin tsc clean.
